bio.text: Kim Ahern won the Democratic primary for Rhode Island attorney general on September 9, 2026, according to preliminary results, and is on the November 3 general-election ballot.
She served as a special assistant attorney general from 2010 through 2019 under three attorneys general, then as deputy counsel to Gov. Gina Raimondo and deputy chief of staff to Gov. Dan McKee.
She chaired the state's Cannabis Control Commission from its creation in 2023 until she stepped down in October 2025.
Ahern lives in Providence and is a graduate of Providence College and Roger Williams University School of Law.

sources.title: Kim Ahern wins Democratic primary for Rhode Island AG
Ahern joins the 2026 race for R.I.'s next attorney general
